newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTE SEES FULL-YR 97 EARNINGS AT 96 LEVEL.
newsitem.headline: RAUTE SEES FULL-YR 97 EARNINGS AT 96 LEVEL.

text.p: Finnish engineering group Raute Oy said on Wednesday it expected full-year 1997 earnings to be at last year's level.
"The 1997 result before extraordinary items is expected to be at the 1996 level," Raute said in a statement with its January-April results.
In 1996, Raute posted a 14.9 million markka profit before extraordinary items on 765 million markka net sales.
Raute's four-month results showed a 9.8 million markka loss after financial items against a 7.7 million loss in the year-ago period. Net sales fell 26 percent to 163 million markka.
